column_description: Unique identifier for each measurement source.
Description of the source. may be NULL.
Reference to the publication or data source. may be NULL.
Type of source (e.g., publication, internal data, external database). always exactly one of 'publication', 'internal data', 'external database'. may be NULL.
Year of the source. may be NULL.
Authors of the source. may be NULL.
Institution associated with the source. may be NULL.
URL to access the source. may be NULL.
